news.notice.welcome.title: Welcome to ShroudForge
news.notice.welcome.message: Your mods now have a home. Browse, configure, and troubleshoot them here — the game can keep being the game.
news.notice.configuration.title: A small note about settings
news.notice.configuration.message: Mod switches and preferences live in each mod's mod.json. Handy for dedicated servers, or when the UI is taking a coffee break.
news.notice.applySettings.title: When do changes take effect?
news.notice.applySettings.message: Saving is immediate; game changes may need a restart. Asset mods also need preparation while the game is closed. The game likes a clean slate.
news.notice.feedback.title: Found a hiccup?
news.notice.feedback.message: A useful report includes your game version, enabled mods, and steps to reproduce the issue. Check logs for personal information before sharing them.
news.notice.support.title: Enjoying ShroudForge?
news.notice.support.message: Feedback and issue reports help a lot. If you feel like it, you can also buy the project a coffee.
